name: grpc-studio
description: A modern web interface for testing and exploring gRPC services using server reflection

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend"
scripts.dev:all: npm run build:shared && concurrently "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:petstore" "npm run dev:bookstore"
scripts.dev:multi: npm run build:shared && concurrently "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend:multi"
scripts.dev:connect: npm run build:shared && sh -c 'TARGET_HOST=${npm_config_target%:*} TARGET_PORT=${npm_config_target#*:} concurrently "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend"'
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && GRPC_STUDIO_CONFIG=../config/backend.yaml npm run dev
scripts.build:frontend: npm run build:shared && cd frontend && npm run build

author: Prasad Sawant
